column1: # English business terms used inside Hungarian speech, with their correct
# Hungarian forms (AkH. 12, 217: suffixes join directly; a hyphen when the word
# ends in a silent letter or an unusual letter group, e.g. deadline-ra).
# Vowel harmony follows the Hungarian pronunciation (deadline "dedlájn" → back).
# sublative (-ra/-re), inessive (-ban/-ben), misheard forms the speech engine
# types (| separated; a suffix is glued on as the engine would). Empty = skip.
# held-out terms (bench only, never trained) are marked with a leading "!".
